page_title: SOU 1-1 IPS | Southampton v Ipswich 21/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+8' Poor challenge! Jan Bednarek (Southampton) is penalised for tripping and Samuel Allison blows his whistle.
90+7' Surely that's handball by one of the Southampton players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
90+5' 1 - 1 A rebound that flew far from the goal landed at the feet of Samy Morsy (Ipswich) and he perfectly dispatched the ball into the top left corner.
90+5' The resulting set piece from Ipswich is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

90+4' George Hirst (Ipswich) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the roof of the net is denied by a decent save from Aaron Ramsdale. Ipswich earn a corner.
90+4' Conor Chaplin (Ipswich) receives the ball from the set piece on the edge of the box, but fails to score because his shot is blocked.
90+3' It seemed like Leif Davis (Ipswich) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
90+2' Ross Stewart (Southampton) is penalised.
90+1' A substitution has been made. Mateus Fernandes is replaced by Joe Aribo (Southampton).
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
90' The foul by Ross Stewart (Southampton) was seen by Samuel Allison who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
88' The attendance for today's match is 31117.
87' Taylor Harwood-Bellis (Southampton) collects the ball from the free kick and immediately sends his close-range effort just over the crossbar!
87' Southampton failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
87' Southampton are enjoying possession, but one of the opposition players steps in to end the sequence. Southampton force a corner. They send men into the box.

85' Dara O'Shea (Ipswich) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger. The ball goes out of play and Southampton will have a goal kick.
83' Samuel Allison shows a yellow card to Jack Taylor (Ipswich) for a tough tackle.
82' Kieran McKenna has decided to substitute Axel Tuanzebe and he is replaced by Benjamin Johnson (Ipswich).
82' Today's match ends for Tyler Dibling who will be replaced by Adam Armstrong (Southampton).
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Cameron Archer departs the field of play to be replaced by Ben Brereton Diaz (Southampton).
78' Yukinari Sugawara (Southampton) fails to deliver a decent cross from a long-range free kick. The opposition's defence intercepts the effort.
78' Jack Clarke (Ipswich) trips an opposition player and Samuel Allison signals a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Southampton.
78' Ben Brereton Diaz (Southampton) was all set to receive a beautiful pass into a promising position. However, one of the defenders makes a timely clearance.
77' Ben Brereton Diaz (Southampton) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
74' Ipswich take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
73' Kieran McKenna prepares a substitution. Wes Burns is replaced by Conor Chaplin (Ipswich).
73' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and George Hirst (Ipswich) is coming onto the pitch as Liam Delap cannot continue after picking up an injury.
73' Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Good work from Ipswich as they win a corner.
71' Flynn Downes (Southampton) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
69' A long ball forward to Ross Stewart (Southampton) is intercepted.
66' A weak shot from the edge of the box by Lesley Ugochukwu (Southampton) is easily saved by Arijanet Muric.
65' Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Samuel Allison signals.
63' Liam Delap (Ipswich) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
63' The referee shows a yellow card to Flynn Downes (Southampton). No wonder. A clear yellow for bad language.
62' Kieran McKenna has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jack Clarke (Ipswich) replacing Sammie Szmodics.
61' The referee signals a substitution. Jack Taylor (Ipswich) is brought on as a substitute for Jens Cajuste.
61' Samuel Allison shows a yellow card to Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich) for his blatant foul.
59' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Ross Stewart (Southampton) comes onto the pitch so that Ryan Fraser can be given a rest.
59' That's the end of the game for Cameron Archer (Southampton), who is replaced by Ben Brereton Diaz.
59' Adam Lallana goes off the pitch and Lesley Ugochukwu (Southampton) comes on.
57' Wes Burns (Ipswich) crosses the ball forward but it is intercepted.
57' Mateus Fernandes (Southampton) tackles a bit over-zealously and Samuel Allison blows for a foul.
55' A pass by Mateus Fernandes (Southampton) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
54' Ryan Fraser (Southampton) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
54' Dara O'Shea (Ipswich) gets booked for the first time in this match.
53' A defender mistimes his tackle on the edge on the box and let's in Sammie Szmodics (Ipswich). It's a decent effort but his shot flies just wide of the right post.
52' Adam Lallana (Southampton) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Samuel Allison had an easy-decision to make.
51' Leif Davis (Ipswich) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
49' Southampton can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

49' Cameron Archer (Southampton) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Arijanet Muric. It will be a corner kick for Southampton.

48' Axel Tuanzebe (Ipswich) tries to find Wes Burns with a clever through ball from the corner of the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Southampton.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Leif Davis (Ipswich) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.

45+2' Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich) wastes an opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires in a terrific shot from long range straight towards the top left corner, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one! Ipswich have been awarded a corner kick.
45+1' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Ipswich.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.

45' Aaron Ramsdale is a nightmare for the offensive players! Leif Davis (Ipswich) meets a cross on the edge of the penalty area, takes a good first touch and fires a rocket of a shot towards the left post, but the goalkeeper produces a wonderful save. Ipswich have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
45' Ipswich have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Ipswich.
44' Liam Delap (Ipswich) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
44' Dara O'Shea (Ipswich) jumps for a header from the resulting corner kick inside the box and sends the ball in on goal, but the goalkeeper makes a very good save.
43' Leif Davis (Ipswich) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
43' Wes Burns (Ipswich) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked. Ipswich have been awarded a corner kick.
42' Adam Lallana (Southampton) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Arijanet Muric intercepts the ball.
39' Ryan Fraser (Southampton) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.

36' Flynn Downes nearly gets in a one-on-one with the goalkeeper after a defence-splitting pass from Yukinari Sugawara (Southampton), but one of the defenders makes a clearance to snuff out the chance.
33' Leif Davis (Ipswich) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Samuel Allison no option but to blow his whistle.
32' Sammie Szmodics (Ipswich) is penalised for a foul. Samuel Allison had a clear view and blows his whistle.
29' Cameron Archer (Southampton) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
28' Mateus Fernandes (Southampton) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee.

27' OFF THE POST! Cameron Archer (Southampton) drifts into the box to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from close range, but it crashes against the left post. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
25' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Charlie Taylor (Southampton) was quite harsh and Samuel Allison didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
22' Aaron Ramsdale (Southampton) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
21' Aaron Ramsdale (Southampton) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
21' Liam Delap (Ipswich) gets to the ball from the resulting corner kick and attempts to curl it past the keeper. His wild shot sails wide of the goal.
21' Leif Davis (Ipswich) will deliver the corner kick.
20' Leif Davis (Ipswich) latches on to a brilliant through ball in a promising position, but one of the defenders is alert to the danger and dispossess him. Ipswich have a corner.
19' Leif Davis (Ipswich) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
18' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Leif Davis (Ipswich), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

18' Jacob Greaves (Ipswich) receives a nice pass from the free kick and strikes from the edge of the box, but his attempt hits one of the defenders and bounces away off him. Ipswich force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
17' Adam Lallana (Southampton) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement. Ipswich are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
16' Ipswich take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

16' The game is pretty dull as Ipswich are just passing the ball from player to player. Nothing lasts forever, though, and they finally make a mistake, allowing the opposition to pick up the ball. The referee signals a corner kick to Ipswich.
15' Wes Burns (Ipswich) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
15' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Ipswich comes to nothing.

15' A lofted cross from Axel Tuanzebe (Ipswich) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The referee blows his whistle, Ipswich are awarded a corner kick.
14' Wes Burns (Ipswich) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
12' Aaron Ramsdale is equal to the effort from the edge of the box by Sammie Szmodics (Ipswich), pushing the ball around the post to safety.
9' Taylor Harwood-Bellis (Southampton) brings an opponent down and Samuel Allison interrupts the game.
7' Adam Lallana (Southampton) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Samuel Allison blows his whistle for a foul.
5' 1 - 0 Tyler Dibling (Southampton) latches on to a precise pass inside the box and sends in a superb strike that finds its way into the bottom right corner.
3' The goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save as he denies the first-time effort by Jens Cajuste (Ipswich) from the edge of the box.
2' Sammie Szmodics (Ipswich) finds some space inside the box and latches on to a brilliant cross, but he wastes his chance as his shot goes way wide of the left post.
1' Ipswich are ruled offside.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Ipswich will kick-off.
Samuel Allison will referee today's match.
